message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo was one of the bloodiest engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  In total, roughly **45,000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s army) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian forces (Wellington & Blücher) | ~20,000 |

These figures come from contemporary reports and modern historical analyses, and they reflect the combined toll on both sides during the two‑day clash on 18–19 June 1815.
